root_cause_summary: PG&E external grid voltage sag tripped main refinery power feeder causing automated safety flaring.
Wet gas compressor mechanical seal failure resulted in pressure buildup and automated relief venting.
Instrument air line leak caused reformer feed valve closure and brief safety relief flaring.
Controlled startup purge flaring during scheduled hydrotreater turnaround and catalyst loading.
Atmospheric river storm high winds downed on-site sub-transmission line halting reactor feed pumps.
